---
title: "School and College Enrollment Validation"
---

This site validates the [PopulationSim](https://github.com/WFRCAnalytics/TDM-INP-PopulationSim)
synthetic population — the household/person microdata underlying WFRC's travel demand model —
against real K-12 and college enrollment, for the Wasatch Front region (Box Elder, Davis, Weber,
Salt Lake, and Utah counties). School enrollment is compared at the **school district** level;
college enrollment at the **county** level.

PopulationSim doesn't control on school enrollment directly, so each comparison is made two ways:
against the synthetic population's uncontrolled enrollment-status label (the real test of how well
the synthetic population reflects actual enrollment), and against its controlled age-band population
(a sanity bound — age-eligible should meet or exceed enrolled, not match it exactly).

## How this site is built

```{mermaid}
flowchart TD
    subgraph sources["Data sources"]
        UGRC["UGRC / Open SGID\nboundaries, school and college locations"]
        NCES["NCES\nCCD, Private School Survey, IPEDS locations"]
        CENSUS["Census TIGER\ncounties, blocks"]
        TAZSRC["WFRC WasatchFrontTAZ\nTravel Analysis Zones"]
        MAZSRC["WFRC MAZ\n(planned — not yet published)"]
        PSIM["PopulationSim\nsynthetic population (local)"]
        USHE["USHE\nenrollment by student home ZIP"]
        IPEDS["IPEDS\nFall Enrollment survey"]
    end

    UGRC --> GEO
    NCES --> GEO
    CENSUS --> GEO
    TAZSRC --> GEO
    MAZSRC -.-> GEO
    GEO["1_geography.qmd\nschool and college crosswalks"] --> XWALK[("crosswalk_school.csv\ncrosswalk_college.csv")]

    XWALK --> ENR
    USHE --> ENR
    IPEDS --> ENR
    UGRC --> ENR
    NCES --> ENR
    ENR["2_enrollment.qmd\nreal DOE / NCES / USHE / IPEDS enrollment"] --> ENR_OUT[("real enrollment\nby district and county")]

    XWALK --> SYN
    PSIM --> SYN
    SYN["3_synthetic.qmd\nPopulationSim rollups"] --> SYN_OUT[("synthetic enrollment\nby district and county")]

    ENR_OUT --> VAL
    SYN_OUT --> VAL
    VAL["4_validation.qmd\nreal vs. synthetic comparison"]
```

- [**Geography**](1_geography.qmd) — builds two crosswalks that every later step joins against: schools
  to districts and colleges to counties. Both include MAZ rows, so PopulationSim output rolls up
  through MAZ. Blocks are no longer used for these joins.
- [**Enrollment**](2_enrollment.qmd) — real K-12 and college enrollment, from state and federal
  sources.
- [**Synthetic Population**](3_synthetic.qmd) — PopulationSim's synthetic enrollment estimates,
  rolled up to the same district/county geography.
- [**Validation**](4_validation.qmd) — the comparison itself.
